qualifier: generic and oncogenic constitutive, not tied to a specific receptor tyrosine kinase
name: Generic and oncogenic PI3K/AKT signaling activation
rationale: All members concern positive or constitutive PI3K/AKT activation (incl. aberrant PI3K in cancer and PI5P/PP2A/IER3 control), whereas confusables route PI3K through specific receptors (ALK/LTK, MET, FGFR).

qualifier: CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8 endosomal sensing
name: Antigen presentation emphasizing CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8
rationale: Members cover antigen processing with CD1/MHC class Ib lipid presentation, DC receptors and TLR7/8, which separates the theme from MHC class II peptide presentation and monocyte surface-signature confusables.

qualifier: CDC42 and atypical members (RHOU/V/D/J, RND2/3), not RHOA/RAC
name: CDC42 and atypical Rho GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are CDC42, RHOU, RHOV, RHOD, RHOJ and RND2/3 GTPase cycles with their IQGAP/formin effectors and microvillus/Rac-antagonizing outputs, while confusables centre on RHOA/B/C and RAC1-3.

qualifier: checkpoint signaling plus anaphase midzone and spindle elongation
name: Kinetochore checkpoint signaling and anaphase spindle elongation
rationale: Members span spindle assembly checkpoint control, kinetochore-microtubule attachment and chromosome targeting, and anaphase midzone assembly/spindle elongation, distinguishing them from cytokinesis and PLK1/AURKA spindle-formation confusables.

qualifier: endothelial activation and leukocyte-endothelium adhesion
name: Endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular remodeling
rationale: Members regulate endothelial activation, apoptosis and sprouting, leukocyte adhesion/extravasation and vessel remodeling/wound healing, unlike confusables focused on growth-factor production, monocyte activation or smooth muscle migration.

qualifier: cardiomyocyte growth and sarcomere organization
name: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth and sarcomere organization
rationale: All members regulate cardiac muscle adaptation, cardiomyocyte growth or sarcomere assembly, whereas confusables cover heart contraction/rate or skeletal muscle atrophy and calcineurin signaling.

qualifier: BAX/BAK permeabilization of the outer membrane, upstream of apoptosome
name: BAX/BAK mitochondrial permeabilization and cytochrome c release
rationale: Members concern BCL-2 family control of BAX/BAK oligomerization, outer membrane permeabilization and cytochrome c release, distinct from downstream apoptosome/SMAC and BH3-only translocation confusables.

qualifier: glutamate-family interconversion and ammonium homeostasis rather than urea cycle enzymes
name: Glutamate-centered amino acid interconversion and ammonium homeostasis
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine, aspartate, proline, ornithine/arginine and GABA conversion plus ammonium handling, while confusables emphasize urea cycle defects, amino acid transport or glyoxylate/glycine metabolism.

qualifier: KIR/MHC class I recognition and inhibitory control
name: NK cell MHC class I recognition and cytotoxicity regulation
rationale: Members concern NK receptor (KIR) signatures, MHC class I/Ib presentation and positive and negative control of NK and T cell cytotoxicity, unlike confusables centred on T cell activation, proliferation or DC-mediated tolerance.

qualifier: O-GalNAc, complex N-glycan and ganglioside
name: Golgi sialylated O-, N-glycan and ganglioside biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover mucin-type O-glycan and complex/hybrid N-glycan maturation, sialic acid supply, sialylation and ganglioside synthesis, distinguishing the theme from nucleotide-sugar/fucose and ER N-glycan processing confusables.

qualifier: acyl-CoA dehydrogenase spiral steps from long to medium chain
name: Mitochondrial beta-oxidation cycles of long- to medium-chain acyl-CoA
rationale: Members are the acyl-CoA dehydrogenase-driven beta-oxidation rounds from palmitoyl- to octanoyl-CoA plus unsaturated fatty acid oxidation, lacking the carnitine shuttle, ketone body and peroxisomal content of confusables.

qualifier: deoxyribonucleoside monophosphate and deoxyribonucleoside breakdown
name: Deoxyribonucleoside monophosphate and deoxyribonucleoside breakdown
rationale: Members concern turnover of dCMP, dGMP and 2'-deoxyribonucleosides, unlike confusables on dNTP biosynthesis/salvage or ribonucleotide and nucleobase catabolism.

qualifier: ventricular wall, septum, endocardium and coronary vessel formation
name: Ventricular wall, septal, endocardial and coronary heart morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover trabeculation/compaction of ventricular and atrial myocardium, septum morphogenesis, endocardium and coronary vasculogenesis, while confusables emphasize heart tube, second heart field, conduction system or valve/cushion development.

qualifier: ATF6/CREB3 transcriptional arm and IRE1/PERK modulation
name: ATF6/CREB3-arm unfolded protein response and IRE1/PERK modulation
rationale: Members center on ATF6 and CREB3 chaperone induction, ER overload and regulation of IRE1/PERK branches and ER-stress apoptosis, lacking the ATF4/XBP1 and translational-control content of confusables.

qualifier: Nodal antagonism and extracellular ligand sequestration
name: Left-right patterning by Nodal antagonism and extracellular ligand sequestration
rationale: Members cover organ left/right asymmetry, nodal cilia movement, negative regulation of Nodal and extracellular sequestration of ligands such as BMP, distinguishing the theme from somitogenesis, motile cilium assembly, gastrulation and planar polarity confusables.

qualifier: aminoacylation plus methylation and pseudouridylation
name: tRNA aminoacylation, methylation and pseudouridylation
rationale: Members cover cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation and tRNA (plus mRNA/rRNA) methylation, pseudouridylation and wobble modification, unlike confusables on wybutosine/diphthamide, t6A or tRNA end processing.

qualifier: NADPH regeneration (pentose phosphate, isocitrate) and ferroptosis suppression
name: NADPH-producing metabolic redox control and ferroptosis suppression
rationale: Members link NADPH-generating pentose phosphate and isocitrate metabolism under NRF2, p53 and mTORC1 control to redox state, ROS and ferroptosis resistance, whereas confusables emphasize broad NRF2 targets, hypoxia/glycolysis or ROS detoxification.

qualifier: APP turnover, tau tangle assembly and microglial activation
name: APP turnover, tau tangle and microglial regulation in neurodegeneration
rationale: Members regulate APP synthesis/catabolism, neurofibrillary tangle assembly, microglial activation and glucosylceramide breakdown, distinguishing the theme from amyloid-beta formation/clearance, glial and amyloid fibril confusables.

qualifier: SLC6A2 norepinephrine transporter
name: Norepinephrine transporter-mediated reuptake
rationale: All members concern norepinephrine uptake by SLC6A2 and its defect, unlike confusables on GABA or serotonin transport, catecholamine synthesis or adrenergic signaling.

qualifier: PTEN control by ceRNAs and localization, and oncogenic AKT activation
name: PTEN-AKT axis: ceRNA control and oncogenic disruption
rationale: Members concern PTEN-dependent restraint of PI3K/AKT (ceRNA/lncRNA control of PTEN, PTEN localization, IGF receptor dampening) and its oncogenic loss or AKT1 E17K activation, distinguishing them from PTEN stability/ERBB2 and inositol phosphate confusables.

qualifier: intraflagellar transport and assembly-disassembly control
name: Intraflagellar transport and cilium assembly-disassembly balance
rationale: Members cover anterograde and retrograde intraflagellar transport and positive and negative regulation of cilium assembly, disassembly and centriole elongation, unlike basal body, centrosome and ciliary cargo-targeting confusables.

qualifier: full beta-oxidation spiral with carnitine shuttle and ketone body turnover
name: Mitochondrial beta-oxidation with carnitine shuttle and ketone body turnover
rationale: Members span carnitine shuttle entry, every beta-oxidation round from palmitoyl- to acetyl-CoA, and ketone body synthesis and utilization, distinguishing them from carnitine transport defects and peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation confusables.

qualifier: lipid droplet formation and glycerolipid synthesis regulation in adipogenesis
name: Adipogenic lipid droplet formation and glycerolipid synthesis regulation
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation/fusion, triglyceride and phospholipid synthesis regulation, fatty acid homeostasis and adipogenesis, whereas confusables emphasize lipolysis, lipophagy and triglyceride catabolism or biosynthetic enzymes.

qualifier: aquaglyceroporin channels for glycerol and urea
name: Aquaglyceroporin glycerol and urea transmembrane transport
rationale: All members concern glycerol or urea passage across membranes via aquaglyceroporins, unlike confusables on fatty acid transport, glycerol metabolism or vasopressin-regulated water reabsorption.

qualifier: full cycle of synthesis, release, reuptake and degradation
name: GABA synthesis, release, reuptake and degradation
rationale: Every member concerns GABA synthesis, catabolism, secretion or uptake, distinguishing the theme from glutamate transport, vesicular loading and lysine/glycine catabolism confusables.
